description: Called when a function call was held for human approval and its inbox record written. Event: PendingApprovalRecord with status "pending" (redacted args, session context). No args; filter on input.session_id or input.session_metadata.<key>. Observe it from notification workers.

AccessRequest.description: The filesystem access ask parsed from the shell/coder `filesystem_access_request` tail. Only present on `kind: "filesystem_access"` records.

attempted_path.description: The raw offending path from the request, as sent by the caller.

error_code.description: The jail-scope rejection code that produced this hint (`S215`, `S220`, `C215`, `C220`).

requested_root.description: Canonical root a grant should target (existing directory, or nearest existing ancestor directory of the offending path).

oneOf.description: A function call held by `approval::gate` (the normal case).

A function call held by `approval::filesystem-access-watch` after a jail-scope rejection carrying a `filesystem_access_request` — the console should ask "allow access to `requested_root`?" instead of a generic approve/deny prompt.

PendingStatus.description: A record in the inbox is pending until it is resolved.

request_schema.description: Event of `approval::on-pending-created` — the inbox record just written, with `status: "pending"`.

arguments_excerpt.description: Redacted — safe to forward to notification channels.

assistant_excerpt.description: First text block of the assistant message that contained this function_call. Best-effort; not derivable from the `pre_call` `HookInput` in v1, so always omitted today.

session_metadata.description: Tenancy + routing (what observers filter on as `input.session_metadata.<key>`).
